call_points.text: Standalone EBITDA per tonne fell 6% YoY to ₹852/t in Q2FY27 from ₹902/t due to seasonal cost absorption.
Management expects double-digit volume growth in FY27, driven by incremental volumes of at least 2.5 million tons.
Industry demand is expected to grow at 6% to 8% in FY27.
Company expects about ₹50 per ton cost savings in FY27, driven mainly by green power and AFR.
Gross debt as of March 31, 2026 stood at ₹5,136 crores with net cash of ₹1,765 crores and net debt of ₹3,370 crores.
Grey cement volume growth was driven by extended footprint in the Central Region and East Market.
Pet coke prices increased significantly due to the geopolitical situation arising out of the US-Iran War.

timeline.summary: On April 23, 2026, JK Cement announced it was declared the preferred bidder for the Karunda Limestone Block-I in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan.
On April 26, 2026, JK Cement announced it was declared the preferred bidder for the Maliyakheri Limestone Block-I in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan.
On April 27, 2026, JK Cement announced an investment of ₹4.22 Cr to acquire a 26% stake in Truere Guj SPV Private Limited for captive solar power.
JK Cement received a minor GST demand order of ₹0.08 Cr from the Ahmedabad tax authority.
On May 20, 2026, JK Cement announced the receipt of a Letter of Intent from the Government of Madhya Pradesh for a limestone mining lease over 349.71 hectares in Panna district.

On May 20, 2026, JK Cement announced the receipt of a Letter of Intent from the Government of Andhra Pradesh for a limestone mining lease over 1,188 hectares in YSR Kadapa District for Dommarnandyala Block-3.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,887.5 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹332.91 Cr.
JK Cement reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,888 Cr and PAT of ₹331 Cr.
JK Cement hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 25, 2026, outlining double-digit volume growth expectations and robust capex plans.
On June 5, 2026, JK Cement announced the execution of the mining lease for the Mahan Coal Mine in Singrauli, Madhya Pradesh, over 981.75 hectares.
JK Cement approved a new ₹130 Cr paint plant in Telangana and recommended Price Waterhouse as statutory auditors from 2027.
JK Cement published its Q2FY27 investor presentation, confirming 40 MTPA capacity by FY28 and 50 MTPA by FY30.
JK Cement filed its Q2FY27 security cover certificate
